title: Regionalized latency signal pipeline and visualization for endpoints/models/zones
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Build a region-aware signal pipeline and visualization surface that computes stable 95th and 99th latency estimates per endpoint route, model variant, and region/zone, and surfaces regressions via dashboards and regression detectors. Background: Current telemetry aggregates quantiles at a service level and loses important cross-slice signals (e.g., model variants with longer KV cache priming, region-specific kernel mismatch). This work will enable fast RCA, regression detection, and rollout gating for model upgrades and routing policy changes. The system must scale to production traffic (hundreds of thousands of requests/sec in aggregate) with bounded CPU/memory and manageable cardinality. Key innovations: 1) hybrid quantile estimator: per-shard t-digest for high-throughput windows + periodic reservoir-backed exact sample ingestion for critical slices; 2) adaptive sampling knobs driven by tokens/sec pressure to keep cost predictable; 3) tokens/sec heatmap alongside percentiles to help distinguish throughput-driven quantile shifts from latency regressions; 4) a playback-based synthetic harness to validate estimator fidelity and regression detection thresholds under controlled noise and burst scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end pipeline emits 95th and 99th estimates for each (route, model_tag, region) every 60s
Grafana dashboard with matrix view for routes x models x regions and drill-down to raw sample inspector
Automated regression detector that raises alerts when p99 increases by >20% and absolute p99 crosses configured SLO
Regression test harness that replays production-like traces and reproduces baseline p95/p99 within 10% error
Adaptive sampling keeps telemetry cost growth <15% during peak load compared to baseline
design_notes: Quantile algorithm: use t-digest shards per collector instance; periodic merge with cluster aggregator. For critical slices (customer-facing routes, high-traffic models) also materialize reservoir samples for forensic queries.
Windowing: sliding 60s windows with 10s step to provide near-real-time updates without thrash.
Cardinality strategy: canonicalize model_tag (version+quantization tag) and region -> use coarse tombstoning for low-traffic combos to limit series explosion.
Tokens/sec correlation: collectors compute tokens/sec histogram per route to expose correlations between throughput and percentile shifts in dashboards.

Privacy/compliance: avoid logging request payloads; only metadata (route, model_tag, region, latency_ms, tokens_count) are emitted. KMS integration for aggregator metadata store enforced per security review.
Failure modes: graceful degradation to coarse quantiles when aggregator lag >2 windows; emit health markers to console for autoscaling decisions.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 - Collector agent: add t-digest encoder and tokens/sec bucketer to runtime sidecar (ENG-122000)
Phase 2 - Aggregator service: implement merge protocol, per-slice retention, and reservoir sampler endpoints (ENG-122001)
Phase 3 - Dashboards & Regression Detector: Grafana panels, alert rules, and Playbook links
Phase 4 - Synthetic harness & validation: extend replay tool to produce tokenized traces and introduce noise injection scenarios
Phase 5 - Rollout: Canary on dedicated pool -> region by region -> global
PRs: backend change set: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4512; aggregator infra: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/1789
testing_plan: Unit tests for t-digest merge semantics and reservoir exporter
Integration tests: deploy collector+aggregator to staging and run replay of 24h sampled traffic; assert p95/p99 within 10% of ground truth
Stress test: extended synthetic run at 2x production TPS for 1 hour to observe memory/CPU scaling
Chaos test: kill aggregator nodes during window merge and validate graceful fallback and alert generation
rollout_plan: Canary 1: small dedicated pool (internal traffic only) for 48h, validate dashboards and false positive rate of regression detector
Canary 2: one market region (us-west-2) at 25% traffic for 72h, monitor tokens/sec delta and estimator error
Full rollout: automated ramp if canaries pass with no critical alerts for 7 days
Rollback: disable aggregator merging and revert collector flag; traffic will fall back to existing coarse aggregates
monitoring_playbook: Alert: p99_regression_high -> Slack #infra-observability, page on-call (severity P1); include top-5 (route,model,region) slices contributing to delta
Investigation steps: query raw reservoir samples for the slice, compare tokens/sec, check recent model rollouts, confirm kernel/quantization changes
Mitigations: route to lower-latency model variant, enable prefix caching for affected routes, or temporarily scale dedicated pool
Postmortem: capture baseline and regression fingerprint and add to regression watchlist
